newsitem.title: USA: Cinergy names Madeleine Ludlow CFO.
newsitem.headline: Cinergy names Madeleine Ludlow CFO.

text.p: Cinergy Corp said on Tuesday it named Madeleine Ludlow its chief financial officer, succeeding J. Wayne Leonard.
Leonard last year was named president of Cinergy's energy commodities business unit.

Ludlow joins Cinergy from Enterprise Diversified Holdings Inc, a subsidiary of Public Service Enterprise Group, where she was responsible for the mergers and acquisitions group and corporate risk oversight.
Cinergy is the holding company for Cincinnati Gas & Electric and PSI Energy.
